changelog: - The rep strip's load line also counts open follow-ups by channel — call / e-mail / other, from `nextActionType` (`followUpChannel()`, `src/lib/salesTeamRule.ts`). `GET /api/sales/team` returns them as `followUps`, under the same rule as `overdue` (`canSeeRepOverdue`: admins and the dispatcher; `null` for everyone else) (#3905).

en: On the board, admins now see how many call and e-mail follow-ups each rep has waiting.
tr: Panoda yöneticiler artık her temsilcinin bekleyen telefon ve e-posta takip sayısını görüyor.
de: Auf dem Board sehen Admins jetzt, wie viele Anruf- und E-Mail-Wiedervorlagen bei jedem Vertriebler anstehen.
